_about: A year of past events for the live watchlist, researched on 8 November 2026. The Worker adds these to the feed; new events after this are collected automatically.

events.title: Q3 2025 results: revenue $17.2M, cash $237.3M, runway into 2028
events.detail: The U.S. filing for the KOSTAIVE COVID vaccine was delayed indefinitely, a third ARCT-032 cohort is testing 15 mg, more Q4 cost cuts are planned, and the CF Phase 3 start was pushed to 2027.

events.title: CFO Andy Sassine to leave; controller named interim finance chief
events.detail: Sassine left the board on 11 December and his employment ends on 31 December 2025.

events.title: Q4/FY2025 results: FY revenue $82.0M, cash $232.8M, runway into Q2 2028
events.detail: The safety committee cleared ARCT-032 for a 12-week Phase 2 study in up to 20 patients, and KOSTAIVE won UK MHRA approval in January.

events.title: Q1 2026 results: revenue $2.1M, cash $213.4M; ARCT-032 12-week cohort enrolling
events.detail: Cohort 4 enrolment started in March, earlier than planned; an FDA Type C meeting in March set a path to a pediatric ARCT-810 study; and the company named a new CFO and CMO.

events.title: Thermo Fisher collaboration to advance ARCT-032 for CF
events.detail: Thermo Fisher will provide financial support, Phase 3 manufacturing and clinical services (through PPD) and get exclusive commercial manufacturing rights; the stock rose about 8%.

events.title: Q2 2026 results; CSL Seqirus deal terminated, Arcturus regains KOSTAIVE rights
events.detail: CSL pays $12M in cash and releases about $16M of liabilities; cash was $191.5M with runway through end-2028, and the ARCT-032 Phase 3 decision is due in Q4 2026.

events.title: ARCT-810 OTC deficiency interim Phase 2 data; LUNAR 2.0 platform unveiled
events.detail: At 0.5 mg/kg, mean glutamine reached the normal range and the drug was well tolerated; the next-generation candidate ARCT-2601 is planned, and Arcturus agreed to buy the AI company myNEO.

events.title: Q3 2026 results: revenue $18.3M (incl. $12M CSL payment), cash $184.8M
events.detail: ARCT-032 Phase 2 enrolment should finish by year-end and Cohort 4 data are due in Q2 2027; new PKU and gout programmes were added, and the myNEO acquisition closed.

events.title: Long-term PRISM data back 4D-150 as durable wet AMD backbone therapy
events.detail: Over 1.5 to 3.5 years of follow-up, supplemental injections fell 92-94% in recently diagnosed patients, and only 2 of 71 patients (2.8%) had mild, transient inflammation.

events.title: 4DMT prices $100M offering of stock and pre-funded warrants at $10.51
events.detail: The raise sold about 8.4M shares plus 1.1M pre-funded warrants on the same day as the PRISM data, diluting existing holders.

events.title: Q3 2025 results: $372M cash plus ~$93M raise and $85M Otsuka upfront
events.detail: Runway is guided into H2 2028, with 4D-710 AEROW interim CF data promised by year-end 2025.

events.title: Kristian Humer appointed Chief Financial Officer
events.detail: Humer is a former Citi healthcare banker who was most recently CFO of Viridian and Foghorn Therapeutics.

events.title: Positive interim 4D-710 AEROW data in CF; 2.5E14 vg Phase 2 dose chosen
events.detail: In 16 people who were ineligible for or intolerant of CFTR modulators, ppFEV1, LCI and quality-of-life measures improved through one year, with no drug-related severe adverse events at the lower doses.

events.title: 2026 guidance: $514M cash, runway into H2 2028, catalyst list
events.detail: Guided milestones were 4FRONT-1 enrollment in Q1, DME Phase 3 start in Q3, SPECTRA 2-year data and a 4D-710 update in H2 2026, and 4D-175 parked pending funding.

events.title: 4FRONT-1 Phase 3 (4D-150, wet AMD) completes enrollment
events.detail: The trial over-enrolled to more than 500 patients, with 52-week topline data expected in H1 2027.

events.title: FY2025 results: $514M cash, runway into H2 2028
events.detail: The Phase 2 of 4D-710 is ongoing and fully funded by the CF Foundation, and the Otsuka deal added $85M upfront with up to $336M in milestones.

events.title: Q1 2026 results: $458M cash, runway into H2 2028
events.detail: 4FRONT-1 randomized 523 patients, PRISM 2-year data were moved to Q3 2026, and the 4D-710 update is still guided for H2 2026.

events.title: Up to $200M credit facility from Hercules Capital; $20M drawn
events.detail: Beyond the initial $20M draw, the further tranches of $30M, $100M and $50M depend on company option, milestones or lender approval.

events.title: 4FRONT-2 global Phase 3 (4D-150, wet AMD) completes enrollment
events.detail: The trial over-enrolled beyond its planned N>500, with 52-week topline data expected in H2 2027.

events.title: Positive 2-year PRISM Phase 2b data at ASRS in wet AMD
events.detail: Treatment burden fell 78% overall (87% in recently diagnosed patients), vision was maintained, and no new inflammation cases appeared after about week 28.

events.title: Q2 2026 results: $430.6M cash, runway into at least H2 2028
events.detail: The release moved 4FRONT-1 topline to Q2 2027 and guided SPECTRA DME 2-year data and a 4D-710 AEROW update for Q4 2026.

events.title: 4D-150 enters Phase 3 in DME with 4SIGHT trial (N=514)
events.detail: First patients are enrolled in the global non-inferiority trial against aflibercept 2 mg, with the primary endpoint on BCVA at week 52.

events.title: 4DMT Investor Day in NYC on 4D-150 clinical and commercial vision
events.detail: The event had KOL panels with four retina specialists on 4D-150's profile and launch strategy, and it was announced on 5 October.

events.title: 4DMT to present at November and December investor conferences
events.detail: Scheduled appearances include Guggenheim (10 Nov), Stifel (11 Nov), Jefferies London (16 Nov) and several in early December.

events.title: Guggenheim Healthcare Innovation Conference presentation
events.detail: Scheduled for 4:30 p.m. EST, while the 4D-710 and SPECTRA updates guided for Q4 2026 are still outstanding.

events.title: Barclays Virtual Ophthalmology Day
events.detail: A scheduled retina-focused investor event, likely to centre on 4D-150.

events.title: Q3 2025 results: Vyjuvek revenue $97.8M
events.detail: Vyjuvek revenue rose from $83.8M a year earlier, net income was $79.4M including a $31.4M tax benefit, and cash plus investments stood at $864.2M.

events.title: KB407 (CF) CORAL-1 top-dose interim data show CFTR delivered to lungs
events.detail: In 6 evaluable patients, the inhaled HSV-1 gene therapy reached 29–42% of conducting-airway cells, with no KB407-related serious adverse events; the repeat-dose CORAL-3 study was set to start in 2Q 2026.

events.title: JPM business update: preliminary Q4 2025 Vyjuvek revenue $106–107M
events.detail: Preliminary full-year 2025 Vyjuvek revenue was $388–389M, with about $955M in cash and investments at year-end, ahead of the 12 January J.P. Morgan presentation.

events.title: FDA grants RMAT designation to KB707 for advanced NSCLC
events.detail: This regenerative-medicine designation was based on durable responses seen with inhaled KB707 in the KYANITE-1 study and is Krystal's second RMAT.

events.title: Q4/FY2025 results: Q4 Vyjuvek $107.1M, FY $389.1M
events.detail: FY2025 net income was $204.8M and cash plus investments were $955.9M; 2026 non-GAAP R&D+SG&A guidance was set at $175–195M, and the KB304 Phase 2 start moved to 2027.

events.title: Q1 2026 results: Vyjuvek $116.4M (+32%)
events.detail: Net income was $55.9M and cash was about $1.0B; the KB803 IOLITE trial was fully enrolled, and the FDA gave KB407 and KB111 platform technology designations in April.

events.title: UK MHRA approves Vyjuvek for DEB from birth
events.detail: This was Vyjuvek's fourth major approval after the US, EU and Japan; the MHRA granted it on 15 May, and the UK launch depends on reimbursement.

events.title: KB407 CORAL-1 interim results presented orally at ATS 2026
events.detail: The cystic fibrosis gene therapy data were presented at the American Thoracic Society meeting; the presentation was scheduled in Krystal's 30 April release.

events.title: ASCO 2026: inhaled KB707 + pembrolizumab in NSCLC
events.detail: In late-line lung cancer patients the combination gave a 31% objective response rate and a 75% disease control rate.

events.title: Krystal set to join the S&P MidCap 400
events.detail: Krystal moved up from the S&P SmallCap 600 effective 24 July, which brings index-fund buying.

events.title: Q2 2026 results: Vyjuvek $119.2M (+24%)
events.detail: Net income was $54.8M and cash was about $1.1B; updated KB707 data and registrational plans were pushed to 1H 2027, and KB408 interim data to 2027.

events.title: KB113 shows broad basal cell carcinoma regression in Gorlin syndrome
events.detail: In 3 patients, 83% of 83 lesions regressed, including 85% of lesions that were not injected; Krystal has started FDA discussions.

events.title: Q3 2026 results: Vyjuvek $127.3M (+30%), $400M buyback; timelines slip to 2027
events.detail: Net income was $63.1M and cash was $1.2B; KB803 topline moved to early 2027 and KB407 interim data to 1H 2027, and the stock fell despite beating forecasts.

events.title: Matthew Hawryluk appointed Chief Business Officer
events.detail: He oversees business development, corporate strategy and alliance management.

events.title: Q3 2025 results: cash $227.0M, runway into 2027; new Wilson disease data at AASLD
events.detail: The net loss was $50.6M, the AATD IND/CTA filing was guided for mid-2026, and new preclinical PM577 data were presented at the AASLD liver meeting.

events.title: NEJM publishes PM359 data in chronic granulomatous disease; ASH poster
events.detail: Two patients reached 69% and 83% DHR+ neutrophils by Day 30, well above the 20% threshold expected for clinical benefit.

events.title: FY2025 results: cash $191.4M, runway into 2027
events.detail: The FY net loss was $201.1M; Prime plans a PM359 BLA after FDA alignment and expects preclinical CF proof-of-concept data in 2026.

events.title: Svetlana Makhni appointed Chief Financial Officer
events.detail: She brings more than 20 years of biotech CFO and investment banking experience ahead of the first clinical trials of Prime's liver programmes.

events.title: Q1 2026 results: cash $149.2M, runway into 2027
events.detail: The net loss was $49.1M, with G&A costs up because of the Beam arbitration.

events.title: New Zealand clears CTA for PM577a in Wilson disease
events.detail: This is Prime's first clinical authorisation for an in vivo prime-editing therapy.

events.title: FDA grants RMAT designation to PM359 for chronic granulomatous disease
events.detail: RMAT makes the drug eligible for rolling and priority review of a BLA, which is planned for 1H 2027.

events.title: Prime wins binding arbitration with Beam over AATD programme PM647
events.detail: The tribunal found PM647 is within Prime's field, found no breach and awarded no damages, which keeps the AATD programme going.

events.title: FDA clears IND for PM577a in Wilson disease
events.detail: Together with the New Zealand clearance, this allows a global Phase 1/2 trial, with initial data expected in 2027.

events.title: Q2 2026 results: cash $108.8M, runway into 2027
events.detail: The net loss was $42.1M, and the PM647 IND/CTA filing was guided for Q3 2026.

events.title: FDA clears IND for PM647 in alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency
events.detail: The first-in-human Phase 1/2 trial will start with lung-only adults, and initial data are expected in 2027.

events.title: First patient dosed in global Phase 1/2 trial of PM577a in Wilson disease
events.detail: This is Prime's first in vivo prime-editing patient; the FDA also granted PM577 Rare Pediatric Disease designation.

events.title: Q3 2025 results: $325.0M cash, runway into 2028
events.detail: Cash was up from $168.0M at the end of 2024, and topline data from both the SION-719 Phase 2a and the SION-451 dual-combination Phase 1 were guided for mid-2026.

events.title: Sionna to present at 44th J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference
events.detail: Sionna announced a JPM presentation on 13 January 2026, ahead of its mid-2026 CF data readouts.

events.title: Q4/FY2025 results: $310.3M cash, runway into 2028
events.detail: FY2025 net loss was $75.3M, and both topline readouts (SION-719 Phase 2a and SION-451 dual combination) were still guided for mid-2026.

events.title: PreciSION CF Phase 2a (SION-719 add-on) completes enrollment
events.detail: Enrollment finished in the SION-719 add-on-to-Trikafta proof-of-concept trial, with topline data expected in summer 2026.

events.title: Q1 2026 results: $289.9M cash, runway into 2028
events.detail: Q1 net loss was $26.8M (vs $16.5M a year earlier), both readouts were guided for summer 2026, and the shares fell about 10% on the day.

events.title: Q2 2026 results: $268.3M cash, runway into 2028
events.detail: Q2 net loss was $29.9M, with both topline readouts still guided for summer 2026, four days before the data came out.

events.title: SION-719 Phase 2a misses sweat chloride endpoint; shares fall ~90%
events.detail: The placebo-adjusted sweat chloride change was only -1.0 mmol/L (p=0.7) in 15 F508del-homozygous adults, so SION-719 will not advance as an add-on to standard of care.

events.title: Phase 1 dual-combination trial meets safety/PK goals; SION-451 + SION-2222 preferred
events.detail: In 120 healthy volunteers the trial met its safety, tolerability and exposure objectives, and SION-451 + SION-2222 was chosen as the lead combination.

events.title: Sionna cuts ~46% of workforce; runway extended into H2 2029
events.detail: The restructuring is expected to cost about $6.4M in charges and stretches cash of roughly $268M into the second half of 2029.

events.title: SION-451 + SION-2222 to enter AscenSION CF Phase 2a in Q1 2027
events.detail: The open-label, 28-day trial will switch F508del-homozygous adults off Trikafta, and a post hoc PreciSION CF analysis showed up to -8.6 mmol/L once PK outliers were excluded.

events.title: NACFC 2026 oral talk: post hoc SION-719 data and NBD1 preclinical data
events.detail: The presentation reported a -8.6 mmol/L sweat chloride reduction after excluding three likely non-adherent participants and a possible interaction with Trikafta's ivacaftor.

events.title: Sionna to present at Guggenheim and Stifel healthcare conferences
events.detail: Sionna announced fireside chats on 9 November (Guggenheim) and 10 November 2026 (Stifel), its first major investor appearances since the restructuring.

events.title: Guggenheim Healthcare Innovation Conference fireside chat
events.detail: Scheduled for 10:30 a.m. ET, it is a chance for management to update the AscenSION CF plans and cash outlook.

events.title: Stifel 2026 Healthcare Conference fireside chat
events.detail: Scheduled for 8:40 a.m. ET, with a webcast on Sionna's investor site.

events.title: Q3 2025 results: revenue $3.08B (+11%); FY25 guidance narrowed to $11.9–12.0B
events.detail: Non-GAAP EPS was $4.80 versus $4.38 a year earlier, and CASGEVY sales of about $17M came in below what analysts expected.

events.title: Zimislecel (T1D) Phase 3 dosing paused pending internal manufacturing analysis
events.detail: Enrollment was complete, but finishing dosing was put on hold, which put the planned 2026 filing for the type 1 diabetes cell therapy in doubt.

events.title: Updated RUBY-3 povetacicept data in IgAN and pMN presented at ASN Kidney Week 2025
events.detail: Longer-term Phase 1/2 data showed proteinuria kept falling in both kidney diseases, and Vertex held an investor event at the meeting.

events.title: First CASGEVY data in children aged 5–11 presented at ASH; global filings planned
events.detail: Pivotal pediatric data were consistent with results in patients 12 and older, and Vertex said it would file worldwide to widen the age range.

events.title: JPM pipeline update: CASGEVY passed $100M in 2025; FDA priority voucher for pediatric filing
events.detail: Vertex set its 2026 milestones, including completing the povetacicept IgAN BLA in 1H26 and expecting JOURNAVX prescriptions to more than triple.

events.title: Exclusive global license from WuXi Biologics for a trispecific T-cell engager
events.detail: Vertex paid an undisclosed upfront fee for a preclinical immunology asset, adding to its pipeline.

events.title: Q4 2025 results: revenue $3.19B (+10%); FY26 guidance $12.95–13.1B
events.detail: Full-year 2025 revenue was $12.0B (+9%), and Vertex guided to at least $500M from non-CF products in 2026.

events.title: JOURNAVX Phase 4 data at AAPM: 90.9% opioid-free after aesthetic surgery
events.detail: In an open-label study of 99 patients, 90.7% rated the non-opioid painkiller's effectiveness as good or better.

events.title: Phase 3 RAINIER: povetacicept meets primary and all secondary endpoints in IgAN
events.detail: Week-36 interim analysis showed a 49.8% placebo-adjusted cut in proteinuria (p<0.0001), clearing the way for an accelerated-approval filing.

events.title: Rolling BLA for povetacicept in IgAN completed with priority review voucher
events.detail: Using the voucher shortens the expected FDA review to 6 months from acceptance instead of 10.

events.title: FDA expands ALYFTREK and TRIKAFTA labels to cover ~95% of US CF patients
events.detail: The labels now cover 564 (ALYFTREK) and 521 (TRIKAFTA) CFTR variants, with ALYFTREK approved from age 6 and TRIKAFTA from age 2.

events.title: Q1 2026 results: revenue $2.99B (+8%); FY26 guidance reiterated
events.detail: Non-GAAP EPS was $4.47 versus $4.06, and the US CASGEVY filing for ages 5–11 was completed.

events.title: VX-522 inhaled mRNA CF therapy (with Moderna) discontinued over tolerability
events.detail: The Phase 1/2 study was stopped early for persistent tolerability problems, ending the program aimed at the roughly 10% of CF patients who can't use modulators.

events.title: Zimislecel T1D study resumes dosing after manufacturing analysis
events.detail: The manufacturing analysis was finished and several patients have been dosed since the restart, with updated timelines promised later in 2026.

events.title: CASGEVY reimbursement agreement reached in Germany
events.detail: The deal secures paid access for SCD and TDT patients 12 and older in a major European market.

events.title: FDA accepts povetacicept BLA for IgAN accelerated approval; PDUFA Nov 30, 2026
events.detail: Acceptance set a decision date for what could be Vertex's first kidney-disease drug.

events.title: Pivotal ALYFTREK data in ages 2–5 presented at European CF Conference
events.detail: Switching from TRIKAFTA cut sweat chloride by a further 9.6 mmol/L, with 92% of children below the 60 mmol/L diagnostic threshold.

events.title: CASGEVY data in ages 5–11 presented at EHA; more global filings announced
events.detail: This was the first European presentation of the pediatric data, and Vertex said it had filed in Saudi Arabia and the UK for children 5 and older.

events.title: FDA approves CASGEVY for SCD and TDT patients aged 2 and older
events.detail: The expansion, approved under a Commissioner's National Priority Voucher, makes about 5,500 more US children eligible.

events.title: Vertex to acquire Crinetics for $85/share (~$10B), a 102% premium
events.detail: The deal adds the approved acromegaly drug PALSONIFY and Phase 3 atumelnant, which together could reach more than $5B in peak sales; VRTX fell about 2% after hours.

events.title: Q2 2026 results: revenue $3.33B (+12%); FY26 guidance raised to $13.1–13.2B
events.detail: Non-GAAP EPS was $4.73 versus $4.52 a year earlier, and guidance did not yet include the pending Crinetics deal.

events.title: FDA clears IND for VX-017, a stem-cell islet therapy for T1D
events.detail: A Phase 1/2 start was planned for the near term, alongside the ongoing zimislecel study.

events.title: Crinetics deal closes; Jonathan Poole named next CFO in leadership reshuffle
events.detail: Poole becomes CFO on Jan 1, 2027, COO Charles Wagner takes on the integration, and Jasper van Grunsven (ex-Amgen) joins as EVP.

events.title: Phase 2b AMPLIFIED inaxaplin data positive; AMPLITUDE enrollment complete
events.detail: In AMKD patients with modest proteinuria, UACR fell 42.7% at week 13, and interim data from the Phase 2/3 AMPLITUDE trial are due early 2027.

events.title: RAINIER povetacicept results published in NEJM and presented at ASN Kidney Week
events.detail: 42.2% of patients on povetacicept reached UPCR below 0.5 g/g versus 6.2% on placebo, five weeks before the PDUFA date.

events.title: UK MHRA approves CASGEVY for patients aged 5 and older
events.detail: The UK authorisation was widened from age 12 and over to children 5 and over with severe SCD or TDT.

events.title: Q3 2026 results: revenue $3.44B (+12%); FY26 revenue guidance raised to $13.15–13.25B
events.detail: Non-GAAP EPS was $4.76; ALYFTREK made $706M, CASGEVY $99M and JOURNAVX $58M, and expense guidance rose after the Crinetics deal.

events.title: VX-017 chosen as lead T1D cell therapy over zimislecel; first VX-828 CF data
events.detail: VX-017 works regardless of blood type and should enter pivotal development in 2027; VX-828 triple therapy cut sweat chloride by 9.4 mmol/L versus TRIKAFTA.

events.title: FDA PDUFA date: povetacicept for IgA nephropathy (accelerated approval)
events.detail: The FDA's decision on Vertex's first kidney drug is the next big binary catalyst for the stock.
